item.description: The Cardinals scored touchdowns on four straight possessions in the second half to a come back, force overtime and earn their third win.
item.media:description: The Arizona Cardinals scored touchdowns on four straight possessions in the second half en route to a come-from-behind overtime win.

item.title: Joe Burrow shakes off turnovers, throws on cape as Bengals escape with OT win over Titans
item.description: The Cincinnati quarterback outdueled Titans QB Cam Ward in a shootout that wasn’t decided until overtime.
item.media:description: Mike Gesicki was one of four pass catchers to haul in a touchdown pass from Joe Burrow on Sunday.

item.title: Jahmyr Gibbs' big day helps Lions hand Vikings first loss of season, tighten NFC North race
item.description: The game between the division rivals was defined by defense through the first three quarters.
item.media:description: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs ran 23 times for 153 yards in Detroit's win Sunday.

item.title: Josh Allen makes history in Bills rout, Ravens back to square one after Lamar Jackson injury
item.description: Jackson will undergo surgery and be placed on injured reserve, meaning he will miss at least the next four games.
item.media:description: Buffalo quarterback Josh Allen threw his 259th career touchdown pass (regular season and playoffs combined) on Sunday, passing Hall of Famer Jim Kelly for the most in Bills history.

item.title: Vikings loss means 1972 Dolphins can celebrate as NFL's final unbeaten team goes down
item.description: The Vikings' dominant defense carried them to a 6-0 start to the season but their struggling offense finally caught up to them.
item.media:description: The Vikings offense finally held them back enough in a xx-xx loss to the Lions.

item.title: Lamar Jackson's return lasts just 1 play before QB suffers potential season-ending thumb injury
item.description: Jackson's hand hit the arm of the Bills' Greg Rousseau while attempting a pass on the Ravens' first offensive snap.
item.media:description: Lamar Jackson injured his thumb when his hand hit a Bills defender.
